title: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori

thread.title: Red River • Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori - Episode 13 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters enjoyed the new opening and ending visuals, with particular appreciation for the stylized artwork and vocal performance.
The new music was seen as catchy and visually appealing, but some felt its modern sound conflicted with the historical atmosphere.
Commenters expressed strong affection for several characters and supporting elements, especially the more sympathetic younger character and the animal companion.
One commenter considered the episode poor overall and criticized the characters’ decisions.
Reactions to the episode’s dramatic character developments were emotionally engaged, combining sympathy, frustration, and appreciation for the tension.

notes: The title and page metadata explicitly identify Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori episode 13. I read the available user comments on this thread, excluding the moderator source-material notice and removed comments. Plot details were omitted from the sentiment summary.
